environment.description: Same NestJS microservice deployed in Kubernetes namespace 'backend-services' with Istio 1.20 service mesh. Sidecar injection is enabled (istio-injection=enabled label on namespace). An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied that uses a source principal match with a namespace-scoped SPIFFE identity. The policy specifies 'action: ALLOW' with a single rule requiring source.namespaces=['backend-services'], meaning only workloads with mTLS identities originating from the same namespace can reach this service. The API gateway lives in namespace 'gateway' and its SPIFFE identity is spiffe://cluster.local/ns/gateway/sa/gateway-sa. Since the gateway's namespace does not match the allow-list, Envoy sidecar returns 403 RBAC denied before the request reaches the application container. A separate AuthorizationPolicy with 'action: DENY' and source.namespaces=['*'] acts as a default-deny fallback. Internal traffic from the 'data-pipeline' namespace batch job (which previously called this endpoint for user lookups) is also blocked.
